scope: read-only independent source review; no remote execution
native_path_closure: examples/extensions plus dependency-free crates/sail-native-resource-ffi; root Cargo manifest and lock identical
mutation_controls: Python -I -B inspection; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 during build; own copied host target; prior target and venv metadata guards
limits: venv and target tree checks are metadata digests, not all-file content hashes
installed native libraries, interpreter, wheel, host, and receipt have content hashes
global Cargo/Rustup caches may change; only seed target and venv are guarded
actual launch image ID must be observed by Docker orchestration in addition to script caller claim
